claim.claim-text: 1. A water outlet device for different water sprays from a same nozzle, comprising:
a water outlet portion, and a control mechanism, the water outlet portion comprises a water outlet nozzle (11), characterized in that:

the water outlet nozzle (11) comprises a water outlet (111), the water outlet nozzle (11) further comprises at least two water inlets (112, 113), flow directions of the water inlets (112, 113) are not parallel to a flow direction of the water outlet (111), the control mechanism is connected to the at least two water inlets (112, 113) to control a water inlet condition of each of the at least two water inlets (112, 113), the water inlet condition comprises at least one of a flow volume and whether the water is flowing or not flowing, and the control mechanism controls the water inlet condition of each of the at least two water inlets (112, 113) to enable the water outlet nozzle (11) to discharge the different water sprays, wherein a cover is hermetically and fixedly connected to a cover plate body to define a water dividing chamber, a water inlet is in communication with the water dividing chamber, and the cover plate body comprises a water passing hole in communication with another water inlet..
2. The water outlet device according to claim 1, characterized in that:

in the at least two water inlets (112, 113), a flow direction of a water inlet (112) is disposed along a direction tangent to the water outlet (111) to enable water from the water inlet (112) to flow into the water outlet nozzle (11) to generate a vortex, and the water inlet (112) defines a first water inlet (112).
3. The water outlet device according to claim 1, characterized in that:

in the at least two water inlets (112, 113), a flow direction of a water inlet (113) intersects with an axial direction of the water outlet nozzle (11), and the water inlet (113) defines a second water inlet (113).
4. The water outlet device according to claim 1, characterized in that:

an installation portion is further provided, the installation portion comprises a cover (1) and a cover plate body (2), the cover (1) is disposed with the water outlet nozzle (11), and the cover plate body (2) is hermetically connected to an inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11).
5. The water outlet device according to claim 4, characterized in that:

the water outlet nozzle (11) is disposed with a surrounding wall (114) protruding from a rear surface of the cover (1) and surrounding the inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11), the surrounding wall (114) comprises a through hole penetrating an inner side and an outer side, the through hole is disposed with a first water inlet (112), a rear end surface of the surrounding wall (114) is concave to define a second water inlet (113) in communication with the inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11), and the cover plate body (2) is hermetically connected to and covers the rear end surface of the surrounding wall (114).
6. The water outlet device according to claim 5, characterized in that:

the surrounding wall (114) comprises a curved wall and a protruding portion (115) connected to two ends of the curved wall, a rear end surface of the protruding portion (115) is concave to define a groove in communication with the inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11), and the groove defines the second water inlet (113).
7. The water outlet device according to claim 6, characterized in that the first water inlet (112) is disposed at a connection position of the curved wall and the protruding portion (115).
8. The water outlet device according to claim 4, characterized in that:

the water outlet nozzle (11) is disposed with a surrounding wall (114) protruding from a rear surface of the cover (1) and surrounding the inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11), the surrounding wall (114) comprises a through hole penetrating an inner side and an outer side, the through hole is disposed with a second water inlet (113), a rear end surface of the surrounding wall (114) is further concave to define a groove, the groove comprises a water passing groove (116), and the water passing groove (116) defines a first water inlet (112) in communication with the inner port of the water outlet nozzle (11).
9. The water outlet device according to claim 8, characterized in that:

the water passing groove (116) comprises a connecting section, an arc section, and a water inlet section, the arc section is connected between the connection section and the water inlet section, and the connecting section is disposed along a tangential line of the water outlet nozzle (11) and is disposed with the first water inlet (112).
10. The water outlet device according to claim 1, characterized in that:

the installation portion further comprises a water divider (3), a fixed base (4), and a water inlet passage (5), the water divider (3) is hermetically and fixedly connected to the fixed base (4) to define a water outlet chamber (31), the water inlet passage (5) is in communication with the water outlet chamber (31), the water divider (3) is hermetically and fixedly connected to the cover plate body (2) to define another water dividing chamber, and the water passing hole (21) is in communication with the another water dividing chamber, and the control mechanism is connected to the water outlet chamber (31) and the two water dividing chambers.
11. The water outlet device according to claim 10, characterized in that:

the water divider (3) comprises one or more water dividing holes (32) of the water dividing chambers, the control mechanism comprises a water dividing plate (33), and the water dividing plate (33) is rotatably connected to the water divider (3) to control the to selectively be in communication with the one or more water dividing holes (32) and to control the flow volume.
12. The water outlet device according to claim 11, characterized in that:

a driving mechanism is further provided, the driving mechanism is operatively connected to the water dividing plate (33) and drives the water dividing plate (33) to achieve a stepless rotation adjustment.
13. The water outlet device according to claim 12, characterized in that:

the driving mechanism comprises a cam-connecting rod mechanism, and the cam-connecting rod mechanism is operatively connected to the water dividing plate (33) to drive the water dividing plate (33) to rotate.
14. The water outlet device according to claim 13, characterized in that:

the driving mechanism further comprises a slider (62), the cam-connecting rod mechanism comprises a push rod (63) and a swing rod (64), the slider (62) and the push rod (63) are configured to slide relative to the installation portion, the slider (62) is operatively connected to the push rod (63) to enable the push rod (63) to slide to drive the slider (62) to slide, the push rod (63) is connected with a connecting pin (631), the swing rod (64) comprises a long slot (641), the connecting pin (631) is coupled in the long slot (641), and the swing rod (64) and the water dividing plate (33) rotate synchronously.
15. The water outlet device according to claim 13, characterized in that:

the cam-connecting rod mechanism comprises a dial rod (67) and a swing rod (64), one end of the dial rod (67) is rotatably connected to the installation portion, one end of the swing rod (64) is connected to the water dividing plate (33), the other end is operatively connected to the dial rod (67), the dial rod (67) rotates to drive other end of the swing rod (64) to swing, and the swing rod (64) swings to drive the water dividing plate (33) to rotate.

16. The water outlet device according to any one or more of claims 12 to 14, characterized in that: the driving mechanism further comprises a push button, the push button is slidably connected to the installation portion, and the push button is operatively connected to the slider.
